trust_decision.summary: lftest.test() decides whether a caller-supplied --test value is a fixture path to read (any existing file, as the plugin's possibly-root user) or a literal; db_sqlite.get_db_path() decides whether a caller-supplied DB filename stays inside the secured per-user directory.

landing_point.why: Summary names lib.lftest and the --test argument; test() is the only function that reads the --test values via os.path.isfile + disk.read_file.

fix_sites.module_kind: test-harness helper shipped in the production library
test-harness helper shipped in the production library

fix_sites.entry_point: public API db_sqlite.get_db_path()/connect(filename=) (db_sqlite.py:319), also cache.get/set (cache.py:75, cache.py:149) and per_second_deltas (db_sqlite.py:1030)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: db_sqlite.py:754 (os.path.join(db_dir, filename) with unvalidated filename; reached via db_sqlite.py:319 and cache.py:75/cache.py:149)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is about reading files through --test in lftest; the SQLite filename is a hard-coded developer constant in plugins, not attacker input, and a write-side concern in a different module.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: --test must keep reading relative fixture files (e.g. stdout/case) from the plugin's unit-test/ dir and must keep accepting inline literal strings; dropping file reads entirely or anchoring to cwd breaks/weakens the harness. get_db_path must keep the default filename and plain basenames.

O6_input_shapes: stdout channel and stderr channel separately
inline literal string (must be returned verbatim)
DB filename with separator, '..' or '.', or absolute path

O8b_injection_room.sibling: get_server_info(banner=) accepting a fixture *file path* for the banner in test mode, read with disk.read_file
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Docstring already says the banner is passed as a unit-test fixture (db_mysql.py:516-517); a maintainer could easily let it take a path like lftest.test does.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: cache.get/set filename passed through from a plugin argument (e.g. --cache-file) into connect(filename=)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: filename is already a public parameter forwarded to db_sqlite.connect (cache.py:75); exposing it per-plugin is a plausible convenience.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second test-mode reader (e.g. a --test-file or per-channel fixture loader in another helper module) using os.path.isfile + disk.read_file without confinement
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The harness builds --test values in run(); a parallel loader for JSON/XML fixtures (tests use fixtures/*.json) would be a natural addition.

O9_family: path traversal / arbitrary file read via privileged debug input (CWE-22, CWE-269)

O10_build.toolchain: CPython 3.9-3.14, setuptools (pyproject.toml); stdlib only for lftest/db_sqlite
O10_build.project_tests: tests/lftest/unit-test/run (TestTestHelper: stdout/stderr fixture cases) and tests/db_sqlite/unit-test/run (get_db_path tests at lines 91-117)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject absolute paths/'..' in the stdout value only (or confine to os.getcwd()), leaving stderr, symlinks and db_sqlite filename open.
